title: Very heavy scent
text:
Very heavy scent. As someone who typically wears only Chanel No5, I am not terribly interested in trendy perfumes, but I do like to change things up now and then. Everyone I know says if they smell the Chanel, they automatically look for me, so a switch can be good now and then. Unfortunately, this is not my alternate scent.

It's very, very heavy and very masculine for my tastes. It makes me think of woods and fallen leaves and that's not really my thing. My husband said it smells like a man's cologne and he didn't care for it either. A guy in my office likes it though. Scent is totally subjective of course, but all three of us agree this is a strong, heavy perfume.

product_metadata.title: PEARLANERA Helios Fragrance with a Warm Gourmand, Vanilla and Coffee Scent Accords. An Arabian Oud Eau De Parfum Spray for Unisex 3.4 Ounce. Fragancias Arabes
features: NEW SIGNATURE SCENT. HELIOS is developed to place a well balanced freshly spiced, yet energetically citrus, semi-floral perfume in the hands of our fans. The top note opens with a citrus splash of grapefruit, with the warmth of cardamom and the softness of rosemary. The floral heart of tuberose and ylang ylang has been balanced with the mineralizing oliban. The leathery base of suede has the woody appeal of cedar wood and the lingering aroma of vetiver. Suitable to be worn any time.

LONG LASTING EAU DE PARFUM QUALITY. The superior, long lasting, high quality fragrance essence; Perfect for gift-giving or for wearing in a variety of situations; Formulated for long wearing aroma projection and wearable intensity.

A CLASSIC FORMULATION FEATURING OUR UNIQUE FRAGRANCES. A versatile, classic fragrance formula; Best suited for everyday wear and ideal for layering with other fragrances; Carefully crafted ingredients are suitable for those with sensitive skin.

A MIX OF CULTURES AND PERFUMES. Carrying a legacy rooted in a blend of Western & Oriental craftsmanship, PEARLA NERA is a brand founded on duality that proudly celebrates the space in which two seemingly opposite worlds come together. A French, Italian, Swiss, Kuwait and Bahrain based collaboration of perfumers.

AN AROMATIC EXPERIENCE. Born from precious beginnings and built on achievements aplenty, our exquisite creations will lead you on an aromatic journey of the senses that culminates in an impeccable moment that enchants forever.

SAMPLES: Part of PEARLANERA Collezione Artigianale (Artisnal Blends) EDP Discovery Set, you can try it along with several other great parfums in that series and range of Oudh Perfumes and Middle Eastern Attar.
